records.title: Text-owned voice loop
records.summary: Voice input should become finalized text before QSF owns the turn, and QSF should produce OutputProduced before any speech output provider receives the exact response text.

records.title: Explicit voice memory source
records.summary: Voice-loop memory should load through an explicit source boundary; the deterministic fixture remains the default, while file-backed memory is selected only by configuration.

records.title: Context budget discipline
records.summary: Retrieved memory must compete under explicit fragment and token budgets so the live loop carries compact context instead of loading everything into the responder.

records.title: Sleep review memory candidates
records.summary: Sleep-phase review can propose reusable memory candidates from session notes, but candidates should remain inspectable and should not become accepted memory without review.

records.title: Provider tool boundary
records.summary: Realtime providers may report tool-call requests, but QSF must record them as events and keep automatic execution disabled until the permission boundary handles them.

associations.reason: QSF-owned voice turns need an explicit memory source before context assembly
